cohort: 143 women with ectopic pregnancies diagnosed and corroborated with histopathological study at Hospital Angeles del Pedregal between 2006 and 2012.
finding: The average age of women with ectopic pregnancies was 32.4 years, 89% were over 25 years old, 35% were primigravidous, 10% had a history of ectopic pregnancy, 39% had 5 weeks gestation, 72% did not use contraceptives, 30% were smokers, and 2% had pelvic inflammatory disease.
